mapped.add_intro: Bring in a repo you already have, or turn a folder into one.
mapped.add_remote_intro: GitLab, Gitea, Codeberg, your own server.

mapped.add_way_publish_sub: Make a new GitHub repo from your notes
mapped.git_m3_both_moved_headline: The remote moved on while you were writing.
